title: Dispersion relation, propagation features and canonical gauge structure of GNLED
summary: We investigate the propagation properties and canonical gauge structure of Generalised Non-Linear Electrodynamics (GNLED) in the presence of a non-dynamical background field. Starting from the quadratic photon sector of the theory, we perform a field redefinition that converts the background-induced derivative coupling into a mass-like contribution characterized by the vector \(V_μ=\partial_μα/α\) where $α= \sqrt{\left.\frac{\partial\mathcal{L}}{\partial \mathcal{F}}\right|_B}$.
